title: App language
hint: Language of the screens and printed receipts, on this browser only. Data — product, customer and shop names, and anything saved or synced — never changes.
thermal.bt: This browser can't print over Bluetooth. iPhone has no such option at all — use “Print invoice”.
thermal.noWrite: No way to send to this device was found — is it a BLE printer?
thermal.usb: This browser can't print over USB. iPhone has no such option at all — use “Print invoice”.
thermal.noOut: No way to send to this printer was found
